## Quick answers

- What is a Tathastu dashboard idol? A compact 3D-printed PLA murti with a flat base for car dash, desk, or home mandir.
- Where are they made? Printed to order in Agra by Tathastu Keepsakes.
- Lowest priced dashboard idol in this set? Lord Shiva Car Dashboard Idol at ₹699.
- Largest size options? Lord Shiva on Nandi up to 8 Inch.
